scientific_role: Defines the multicohort response-prediction setting used for discovery and external evaluation.
Links each expression profile to patient, treatment timepoint and response evidence before model fitting.
Treats CR/PR as response and SD/PD as non-response for the main binary endpoint.
Compares CR/PR against PD after excluding intermediate SD/MR samples.
Evaluates CR/PR/SD or durable benefit against progression/non-benefit where supported by cohort metadata.
Transforms expression into response-high and resistance-high module activities without using held-out labels.
Aggregates biologically signed state-state gene interactions as model features.
Estimates response probability from module and interaction features under class imbalance.
Searches module composition and interaction edges with biological compactness and leakage-safety constraints.
Selects fixed decision thresholds before external cohort scoring.
Keeps probability calibration separated from locked external outcome labels.
Scores external cohorts once and evaluates discrimination and calibration only after predictions are fixed.
Reports module coverage so platform transfer does not silently change the biological score.
Compares EcoNiche-Opt against IFNG/CXCL9/TIG/APM/TIDE-like immune signatures under shared samples.
Separates FDR-supported statements from point-estimate-only improvements.
Maps bulk ecological modules to immune, stromal and myeloid cell-state patterns.
Uses external perturbation resources only to generate mechanistic hypotheses.
Allows independent users to apply the published scoring rule to normalized expression matrices.
Marks access-restricted cohorts as non-shareable while preserving interfaces and analysis rules.
